en.前舱居民还在船的另一头。先靠近，才能稳定伤势和搬运。: The resident is across the ferry. Get close to stabilize and carry them.
en.点右侧「移动」，再点地图上的亮格。先看路线与消耗，点底部「确认行动」才会行动。: Click Move, then a lit tile. Check the route and AP cost. Click Confirm Action below to move.
en.已完成的动作会自动推进教学；取消预览不会扣行动点。: Lessons advance as you act. Canceling a preview costs no AP.
en.绿点：可移动 橙纹：机器预告 字母：目标: Green: reachable · Orange: danger · Letters: objectives
en.指向人物或字母目标，查看状态: Point at a person or objective for details
en.开始救援 · 边做边学: Start rescue · Learn as you go
en.船上还有两位居民。\n带三位伙伴出发，把人接回岸边。:
Two residents are still aboard.
Lead your three-person crew and bring them ashore.
en.先学会移动，再一步步完成救援。\n不用先研究装备、培养或关系系统。:
Learn to move, then rescue step by step.
Gear, training and relationships come later.
en.先让她决定交班单向谁公开: Let her decide who sees the handover sheet.
en.征得同意后安排双方核对: Ask for consent, then review it together.
en.先断开错误回路再用通用交互恢复电源；可单人施工或三人分工，先停机也可。备用组件仅: Disconnect the faulty circuit, then use Interact to restore power. Work alone or share the work; you can shut the machine down first. Spare components are an optional retrieval objective, not a usable battery.
en.施工和停机都用交互。进度达到要求，目标才算完成。: Interact builds or shuts down machinery. Complete all required work.
en.尚未加入 · 第%d个主线结算后出现新的伙伴: Not recruited · Joins after main mission %d
en.上次主任务未完成：本次有一处预告碎石，查看地图后再决定路线。: The last main objective was not completed. This mission has one marked rubble hazard. Check the map before choosing your route.
en.删除岸上值守；开局短支线只保留修船与船票运输。: Remove shore duty. The opening side mission retains only boat repairs and ticket transport.
en.先靠近装置，点「交互」，再点字母目标。查看进度和费用后确认。: Move next to the device. Choose Interact, click its letter, then confirm the preview.
en.任务结果会改变街区状态，并影响后续机会。: Mission results change districts and shape future opportunities.
en.休息 → 故事 → 装备 → 配队；第四晚结束后进入自主阶段。: Rest → Stories → Gear → Team. After night 4, plan your own shifts.
en.伙伴间的信任和共同经历会影响协作，关系紧张时可能需要保障。: Trust and shared experiences affect teamwork. Strained relationships may need safeguards.
en.先制作药品，再在出发准备里装入本次用量，并给队员装备医疗包。制作有资源成本。: Craft medicine, pack it before departure, and equip a crew member with a medkit. Crafting costs resources.
en.先看当前余额与购买费用，再决定是否补充。无需为了提示购买。: Check your balance and the price before buying. This lesson requires no purchase.
en.先看疲劳和自然休息后的状态，再决定是否安排项目。: Check fatigue and overnight recovery before deciding on an activity.
en.先选择项目和参加者，核对总费用、个人状态及项目次数，再确认。: Choose an activity and participants. Check total costs, individual condition, and activity limits before confirming.
en.历史裂痕需要承认问题和后续实际行动，不能只靠聊天消除。: Old wounds need acknowledgement and action. Conversation alone cannot resolve them.
en.后期可以整理证据、公开记录；第23晚需要确定最终路线。: Later, you can review evidence and publish records. Choose the final route on night 23.
en.基础教程完成：移动与救援、夜间恢复、故事、装备和配队。结束今晚后，自主安排；新功: You've covered movement, rescue, recovery, stories, gear, and team selection. End tonight to finish the basics. New features will still be introduced when relevant.
en.多位伙伴都需要恢复时，可以集中安排，减少重复操作。: When several crew members need recovery, a group activity saves repeated selections.
en.完成的现场设施可能提供后续支援，但有可用日期和次数限制。: Restored field facilities may offer support later, with limited dates and uses.
en.已了解；入口保留在营地，可稍后再用。: Learned. The camp shortcut stays available for later.
en.已有的撬棍和医疗包需要配给队员，现场才能使用。: Assign your crowbar and medkit to crew members to use them in the field.
en.当前有伙伴满足带教条件，收益高于普通训练。: A crew pairing now qualifies for mentorship with better gains than ordinary training.
en.打开今晚的故事，选择一个人物，逐页阅读后再决定回应。可以暂缓，不必为了教程作出选: Open tonight's stories and choose a character. Read before responding. You can defer; no choice is required for this lesson.
en.打开城市记录，查看已经发生的事实与街区变化；阅读不消耗夜间项目。: Open the city record to review events and district changes. Reading uses no evening activity.
en.打开旧事，查看当前阶段与已有事实；只有满足条件时才确认修复。: Review the current stage and supporting facts. Confirm a repair only when its conditions are met.
en.拥有医疗包还需要药品，才能在现场治疗。: A medkit also needs medicine to treat people in the field.
en.新工具提供额外方法，但会占用资金、零件和携带位置。: New tools offer more options, but cost credits and parts and take up equipment slots.
en.查看具体关系和未满足的条件，再安排共同出勤或沟通。数值变化不等于历史问题已经解决: Review the relationship and unmet conditions before planning shared shifts or talks. Better scores do not erase past harm.
en.查看设施是否完好、是否需要补修，以及剩余窗口；符合条件时再选择参加者。离开今晚前: Check the facility, any repairs needed, and its remaining dates. Choose participants when eligible. Check the deadline before ending tonight.
en.物资不足时，部分治疗和训练无法安排。: Low supplies can prevent treatment and training.
en.现场的选择会延续到营地。故事可以帮助你理解伙伴的顾虑。: Field choices carry over to camp. Stories help you understand your crew's concerns.
en.经验和训练阶段决定角色能用哪些专长。: Experience and training stages determine which specialties a character can use.
en.结束前认识今晚这一项；无需购买或执行项目。: Read tonight's lesson before moving on. No purchase or activity is required.
en.让两位伙伴在任务后交流，了解彼此。: Let two crew members talk after a mission and get to know each other.
en.设施升级会持续改变后勤条件，适合解决反复出现的需求。: Facility upgrades provide lasting benefits for recurring needs.
en.这里只查看这一件：先比较用途和费用，购买后再分配携带者。现场会另行介绍用法。: Review this tool's purpose and price, then assign a carrier if you buy it. Field use will be taught separately.
en.这里只查看这一处：比较下一等级效果和费用，确认后升级。可以先保留资源。: Review this facility's next upgrade and cost. Confirm to upgrade, or save your resources for later.
en.选一位伙伴查看档案，比较普通操作和专长的实际收益。看到未解锁专长不代表现在能用。: Open a character profile to compare ordinary actions and specialties. Locked specialties are shown for planning; they cannot be used yet.
en.选择一件已有工具和携带者，查看预览再确认。出发前还能调整；本次不需要购买。: Choose an owned tool and a carrier, review, then confirm. You can adjust before departure. No purchase is needed.
en.选择一位伙伴，查看恢复或训练的费用与收益；确认才执行。今晚不安排项目也能继续。: Choose a character and review the costs and benefits of recovery or training. Only confirmation spends resources. You may end tonight without any activity.
en.选择一项查看用途。尚未到使用时机的功能，会在之后出现；关闭手册不会跳过教学。: Choose a feature to learn about it. Other features appear when relevant. Closing this handbook keeps guidance on.
en.选择发起者和交谈对象，先看预览。聊天和夜间项目使用不同的次数限制。: Choose who starts the conversation and who they talk to, then review. Talks have a separate limit from evening activities.
en.选择师生组合，核对经验、物资与双方疲劳。带教占用夜间项目和学员的训练阶段，不必立: Choose a mentor and learner. Check XP, supplies, and both characters' fatigue. Mentorship uses an evening activity and a learner's training stage. You may wait.
en.选择最多三位已入队伙伴，保存下一班阵容。查看疲劳与角色分工，也可以保留原阵容。: Choose up to three recruited crew members and save the next shift. Consider fatigue and roles, or keep your current team.
en.逐项查看条件和后果，先预览再确认。公开范围与路线都由你决定，教程不会替你选择。: Review requirements and consequences before confirming. You decide what to publish and which route to take.
en.陈砚加入后，你可以轮换出勤，让疲劳的伙伴休息。: With Chen Yan on the team, rotate your crew to let tired members rest.
en.人物的计划和已发生的故事都可以回看。: Review character plans and stories you have already experienced.
en.打开记录，核对已经答应的事、当前进展和章节结果。阅读不会作出新的承诺。: Open the records to review promises, progress, and chapter results. Reading makes no new commitments.
en.现在处于证据整理的可用时段，遗漏的记录可能影响后续路线。: Evidence review is available now. Missing records may affect later routes.
en.选择需要复核的记录，查看费用和条件再确认；整理不会自动公开。: Choose a record and review its cost and requirements before confirming. Reviewing does not publish it.
en.已有证据可以公开，是否隐去个人信息会产生不同后果。: You have evidence you can publish. Redacting personal information changes the consequences.
en.比较隐去信息和完整公开的说明，预览后再决定。教程不会替你公开。: Compare redacted and full disclosure, then review before deciding. This lesson publishes nothing for you.
en.下一次出勤将进入终战，需要先确定团队的去向。: The next mission is the finale. Choose your team's route before departure.
en.查看各条路线的条件和已有约定，再选择路线并确认。结束今晚前仍可调整。: Review route requirements and your commitments, then choose and confirm. You can change it until tonight ends.
en.每件工具全队共用一件；选择携带者，预览后确认。出发前仍可调整。: Each tool has one shared copy. Choose a carrier, review, then confirm. You can adjust before departure.
en.带教需要满足合作与成长条件，且收益高于普通训练。: Mentorship requires cooperation and growth conditions, with better gains than ordinary training.
en.今晚暂无可用的带教组合。: No mentorship pairing is available tonight.
en.也请核对今晚剩余项目、双方疲劳和物资；条件满足后，这里会出现可选组合。: Also check remaining activities, both characters' fatigue, and supplies. Eligible pairings will appear here.
en.她把杯子挪开，纸上留下一个圆印。交班人的姓名被水洇成了两团。: She moves the cup. A wet ring marks the page. The two names on the handover sheet have run into blots.
en.林岚：我记得他让我去拿干纱布。我回来，隔断已经降下去了。后来所有人都说，至少那边: Lin Lan: I remember he sent me for dry gauze. By the time I got back, the partition was down. Everyone kept saying, at least the people on that side made it.
en.林岚：我知道。可我的那张名单上，也都是人。: Lin Lan: I know. There were people on my list, too.
en.林岚：先留在这里。我还没想好要把哪一部分交给谁。: Lin Lan: Leave it here for now. I haven't decided who gets to see which part.
en.她把那张纸装进透明袋，袋口没有封死。: She slips the paper into a clear bag and leaves it open.
en.林岚：可以核对时间。但别替我把“愿意听”写成“已经原谅”。: Lin Lan: You can check the times. I said I'd listen. Please don't write down that I've forgiven him.
en.你在抄件上划去姓名，只保留她同意核对的时间段。: On the copy, you cross out the names and keep only the times she agreed to check.
en.林岚在新表格的“最后撤离”一栏写下自己的名字，又把笔停住。: Lin Lan writes her name under “Last to leave” and holds the pen still.
en.林岚：我想先问一句，接应的人没到怎么办？别写“视情况”。写谁通知，谁接替，什么时: Lin Lan: What if my relief doesn't show? Don't put “use your judgment.” Who makes the call? Who takes over? When do I stop waiting?
en.林岚：我负责判断伤情。后面谁接着搬、谁在出口等，也请写上名字。: Lin Lan: I'll assess the injuries. Put down names for the people who'll carry each patient and meet them at the exit.
en.她在职责表上签字：下一次要靠实际交接验证，今晚这张纸还不算。: She signs the roster. They'll know if it works when someone actually takes over.
en.林岚：那我保留医疗判断。需要协助的时候，我会说清楚。: Lin Lan: Leave the medical calls to me. If I need another pair of hands, I'll ask.
en.你们留出了独立处置栏，没有把独立工作写成拒绝团队。: The two of you make room on the form for decisions she can take herself.
en.她把钥匙放下，又把交班表推到你面前。: She sets the key down and slides the handover sheet toward you.
en.林岚：留下还是回诊所，我会自己决定。我今天想知道的是，下次有人接班，我能不能真的: Lin Lan: I'll decide whether I stay or go back to the clinic. What I want to know is, next time someone comes to relieve me, can I really go?
en.林岚：那次交接我看到了。以后出了变化，先告诉我。: Lin Lan: I saw that handover. Next time something changes, tell me first.
en.她把备用钥匙推给值班人，旧交班单仍收在自己的抽屉里。: She slides the spare key across to the person on duty. The old handover sheet stays in her drawer.
en.林岚：工作照做。旧事先不要拿来开解我。: Lin Lan: I'll do my job. Just leave the past out of it for now.
en.她收好钥匙，在公共表格上写下今天的值班时间。: She pockets the key and writes today's shift on the board.
en.林岚：等这轮救援结束，我想回诊所。门口那张椅子总得有人修。: Lin Lan: After this rescue, I'd like to go back to the clinic. Somebody has to fix that chair by the door.
en.她没有交还今天的值班牌，只在后面的计划栏写了一个地址。: She keeps today's shift badge. In the space for future plans, she writes an address.
en.接收器只剩底噪，许舟仍把旋钮转回原来的刻度。: There's only static, but Xu Zhou turns the dial back to the old frequency.
en.许舟：我记得有人喊“现在关”。可那十七秒没录下来。我重复得太多，连自己都怕记错。: Xu Zhou: I remember somebody yelling, “Shut it now.” Those seventeen seconds are missing. I've said it so many times I'm scared that's what I remember now.
en.许舟：修记录可以。修不好也要把缺失写出来。: Xu Zhou: Try to fix the recording. If you can't, make sure the gap stays on the record.
en.他把接收器交给你，留下带日期的原件标签。: He hands you the receiver with its original dated label still on.
en.许舟：我把记得的说一遍。不确定的地方，你就记“不确定”。: Xu Zhou: I'll tell you what I remember. When I say I don't know, write that down too.
en.他的陈述单上留了一段空白，没有被你们补成完整命令。: There's a gap in his statement. Neither of you tries to fill in the rest of the order.
en.他把绳子整理成三圈，第四圈怎么也摆不齐。: He coils the rope three times. The fourth loop refuses to lie flat.
en.许舟：我以前总说“再给我一点时间”。这句话听上去像有办法，其实有时只是我不肯回来: Xu Zhou: “Give me a little longer.” I used to say that all the time. Sounds like I had a plan. Sometimes I just didn't want to come back.
en.许舟：给我划清能自行判断的范围，也给我一个必须回来的时间。: Xu Zhou: Tell me what I can call on my own, and give me a time I have to be back.
en.他在停止条件旁签字，没再加“除非还有一个人”那句小字。: He signs beside the stopping rule. This time there’s no tiny “unless one person’s still out there.”
en.许舟：可以，我单独负责一段。变更之前先报，不让别人替我猜。: Xu Zhou: I'll take a section. If I need to change anything, I'll call it in first. Nobody should have to guess.
en.你们分开岗位，基础接应仍按公开预案进行。: You take separate posts. The usual pickup plan still stands.
en.许舟把湿绳挂好，第一次没有抢着把最后一箱也抱上肩。: Xu Zhou hangs up the wet rope. For once, he lets somebody else take the last crate.
en.许舟：等这一轮结束，我想再上船。不是为了找一场能把旧账抵掉的救援。: Xu Zhou: I'd like to get back on a boat after this. Not to find one big rescue that'll square everything.
en.许舟：按时回来那次，我也觉得自己把活做完了。: Xu Zhou: That time I came back on time? It felt like I'd done the job, too.
en.他把撤离时刻留在记录上，没有把它换成英雄故事。: He writes down the time he got out. He leaves it at that.
en.许舟：你肯把规则说清就够了。别急着替别人说没事。: Xu Zhou: Knowing the rules is enough. Let other people say for themselves whether they're all right.
en.他收起个人陈述，照常领取次日任务单。: He puts his statement away and picks up tomorrow's brief.
en.许舟：救援结束后，我去试一支新船队。今天这一班我会做完。: Xu Zhou: I'll try out with a new crew after the rescue. I'm finishing this shift first.
en.他把申请表夹在旧电台下面，仍等着明天的出发时间。: He slips the application under the old radio and waits for tomorrow's departure time.
en.苏棠从通话纸上剪下一条，剪到号码中间便停住了。: Su Tang cuts a strip from the call sheet. Her scissors stop halfway through a number.
en.苏棠：有几通没接到。我总想，如果我当时没去倒那杯水……可是后来连电也断了。: Su Tang: I missed a few calls. I keep thinking, if I hadn't gone for that glass of water… but then the power went out, too.
en.苏棠：那先分开：没接到的、没电的、已经转接的。别都算在同一栏。: Su Tang: Let's sort these first. Calls I missed, calls after the power cut, calls that got through somewhere else. Three columns.
en.她删掉表头的“我的遗漏”，换成“待核实”。: She crosses out “Calls I missed” at the top and writes “To check.”
en.苏棠：你不用马上告诉我不是我的错。我还想把那天说完。: Su Tang: You don't have to tell me it wasn't my fault. I'd like to finish telling you about that day.
en.你们没打开工作台，只留了一盏桌灯。: Neither of you switches on the console. Only the desk lamp stays on.
en.新的排班表又把她的名字放在两端。她看了好一会儿。: Her name is at both ends of the new roster again. She studies it for a while.
en.苏棠：我会接电话，不代表我不用睡。也别先替我答应，再问我是不是愿意。: Su Tang: Being good on the phones doesn't mean I don't need sleep. And if you need me, ask before you put me down.
en.苏棠：轮班表要问过当事人。轮到我休息，就别因为我还在屋里又算回值班。: Su Tang: Ask the people on the rota first. If it's my break and I'm still in the room, I'm still on my break.
en.她把接替方法写在一张任何人都能拿到的卡片上。: She writes the handover steps on a card anyone can pick up.
en.苏棠：我继续做调度，但任务之外的事请先问我。: Su Tang: I'll keep running dispatch. For anything beyond the job, ask me first.
en.她把公共联系方式和私人号码分开收好。: She puts the public contact details and her own number away separately.
en.她把备用耳机绕好，留了一张操作说明。: She winds the spare headset cord and leaves a note on how to use it.
en.苏棠：今天如果不是我接，先让值班的人处理。真需要我，再叫我。: Su Tang: If someone else is on the phones today, give them a chance to answer. Come get me if you really need me.
en.苏棠：那两次后勤确实换了人，没有再默认把我填回去。: Su Tang: Those two shifts went by without my name slipping back onto the rota.
en.她把自己的名字从默认接替栏里划掉，留给下一次明确排班。: She crosses her name out of the automatic relief slot. Whoever takes the next shift will have to be asked.
en.苏棠：工作上能依靠我，生活里也请让我说“不”。: Su Tang: You can count on me at work. Let me say no on my own time.
en.她把明天的联络安排发到公共板上，然后关掉自己的灯。: She posts tomorrow's contact schedule on the board and turns out her light.
en.苏棠：结束之后我想休一阵子。回来要做什么，等休够再说。: Su Tang: I'd like some time off after this. Ask me what comes next when I've had some sleep.
en.假期写在最终任务之后，没有空掉明天的调度席。: Her leave starts after the final mission. Tomorrow's dispatch shift is still covered.
en.陈砚把验收附页展开，指尖停在自己的签名下。: Chen Yan unfolds the inspection addendum. His finger stops under his signature.
en.陈砚：我写了“整改后使用”，但那不是停工令。我知道问题，却没有坚持停下来。: Chen Yan: I wrote “Fix before use.” That wasn't a stop-work order. I knew there was a problem. I didn't make them stop.
en.陈砚：原件也留着。别人可以核对，我不能只给一份对自己有利的摘抄。: Chen Yan: Keep the original. Anyone checking my story should get more than the lines that make me look good.
en.你登记副本去向，没有宣布任何人已接受解释。: You note where the copies went. Nobody has said they accept his explanation.
en.陈砚：可以问。我先把当时知道什么、没做什么分开讲。: Chen Yan: Ask. I'll start with what I knew at the time, then what I didn't do.
en.这次他没有用设备编号代替受伤的人。: This time he speaks of the person who got hurt, without giving the machine's serial number instead.
en.维修清单很长，他从头念了两项，忽然停下。: He reads the first two jobs off a long repair list, then stops.
en.陈砚：我又在讲机器。叶禾问的是人后来怎么办。账和责任，不能藏进技术报告。: Chen Yan: There I go again, talking about machines. Ye He asked what happened to the people. A repair report won't tell you who owes what, or who's responsible.
en.陈砚：这笔专项补偿按账走。付钱不能换原谅，也不能换撤掉签名。: Chen Yan: Put the compensation through the books. Paying it won't buy forgiveness. My signature stays where it is.
en.8资金记入专项账，后续仍要实际完成承诺才能核验。: Eight credits go into the compensation account. The rest of his promise still has to be kept.
en.陈砚：我先把现在经手的活负责到底。旧案继续查，不拿新维修顶掉旧责任。: Chen Yan: I'll see these repairs through. Keep the old case open. Fixing something today doesn't let me off for what I did then.
en.你们明确当前岗位，保留完整记录。: You set out his duties and keep the full record.
en.他把旧铭牌卸下来，背面还有一小块没擦掉的漆。: He takes down the old nameplate. There's still a fleck of paint on the back.
en.陈砚：修完以后谁负责，不能再等出事才找名字。我的名字写在这里。: Chen Yan: People ought to know who's responsible after the repair, before something breaks. My name's right here.
en.陈砚：该核对的已经核对过。往后这张表，请让别人也能改。: Chen Yan: We've checked what we said we would. Make sure other people can make changes to this sheet, too.
en.他把唯一一支签字笔留在公共台上。: He leaves the only signing pen on the shared bench.
en.陈砚：她不想与我亲近，是她的权利。工作检查照常做。: Chen Yan: She doesn't owe me friendship. I'll keep doing the inspections.
en.检验单多了一栏复核人，没有一栏叫“原谅”。: The inspection form has a new space for a second signature. Nowhere does it ask for forgiveness.
en.陈砚：结束后我回维修台。后勤也要有人把东西修到能放心用。: Chen Yan: I'll go back to the repair bench after this. The supply crew needs things they can trust in their hands.
en.他继续处理本轮任务，转岗日期没有提前。: He gets on with this shift. His transfer date stays where it was.
en.叶禾把复印件压进工具箱夹层。纸边磨损得比工具还厉害。: Ye He tucks a photocopy into the lining of her toolbox. Its edges are more worn than the tools.
en.叶禾：我爸练着重新扣纽扣的时候，他们说流程已经走完了。这里有陈砚的签名。: Ye He: Dad was learning to button his shirt again when they told us the case was closed. That's Chen Yan's signature.
en.叶禾：那就先保留。别为了让我好受，把它收进我找不到的地方。: Ye He: Keep it, then. Just don't put it somewhere I can't find it to spare my feelings.
en.你登记原件归她保管，调查需要另行征求授权。: You note that she holds the original. Anyone investigating will have to ask her first.
en.叶禾：可以比对。不同的地方标出来，别急着挑一张当最后答案。: Ye He: Put them side by side. Mark where they differ. We don't have to pick a winner tonight.
en.两份记录都留在核查表上，未证实部分没有抹去。: Both accounts stay on the sheet, along with the points nobody has confirmed.
en.她把修好的零件放下，没有露出松一口气的表情。: She sets the repaired part down. She doesn't look relieved.
en.叶禾：机器能转了，是机器的事。人受过的伤，不会跟着复位。: Ye He: The machine turns again. Good for the machine. A person's injuries don't reset like that.
en.叶禾：原始记录和复核过程，我都要看得到。结论不由谁声音大来定。: Ye He: I want to see the original records and how they get checked. The loudest voice doesn't get the last word.
en.她同意核查计划，没有同意提前接受结论。: She agrees to the review. She hasn't agreed to what it will find.
en.叶禾：我负责我的设备。涉及那个人的部分，请找独立复核。: Ye He: I'll take care of my equipment. Get somebody independent to check anything that concerns him.
en.你们分清岗位，普通任务仍能同行。: You divide up the jobs. You can still go out on ordinary assignments together.
en.新证据放在旧复印件旁边。叶禾看了两份，没有把任何一份收掉。: Ye He studies the papers beside her old photocopy. She leaves them all on the table.
en.叶禾：如果有新的事实，我会看。不代表以前那些事没发生。: Ye He: If something new comes to light, I'll look at it. It won't undo what happened.
en.叶禾：我看过核查结果了。我能和你工作，也还会问以前的事。: Ye He: I've seen the findings. I can work with you and still ask about what happened before.
en.她把新记录放进同一夹层，旧复印件仍在最前面。: She files the new record in the same sleeve, just behind the old photocopy.
en.叶禾：保持这个距离就很好。需要协作，我们把安全条件说清。: Ye He: This much distance suits me. If we work together, let's agree on the safety checks first.
en.她没有拒领任务，只把复核人的名字重新圈了一遍。: She takes the assignment, circling the reviewer's name once more.
en.叶禾：之后我想带一支社区维修队。不是谁家的临时工。: Ye He: After this I'd like to lead a neighborhood repair crew. I'm tired of being somebody's pair of spare hands.
en.她在计划页画了工具借用柜，正式安排在救援之后。: On the plans page she sketches a cabinet for lending tools. The new job comes after the rescue.
en.贺鸣把名单翻到背面，那里写着一个没有划掉的名字。: He Ming turns the list over. There's a name on the back that nobody has crossed off.
en.贺鸣：我下令退了，回来的人比继续等要多。可那个人没回来。我不愿意把他写成一个“必: He Ming: I called the retreat. More people came home than if we'd waited. He didn't. I can't write “necessary loss” next to his name.
en.贺鸣：那先把他的名字念一遍。后面的结论，晚一点。: He Ming: Say his name first. We can draw conclusions later.
en.你们保留原名单，没有用一个新统计覆盖旧记录。: You keep the original list. A new head count can't replace it.
en.贺鸣：路线可以重看。别把知道后果之后的选择，当成当时谁都该知道。: He Ming: We can go over the route. Just remember we didn't know how it would end when we chose it.
en.你们只标出当时已知的路况和命令。: You mark only the road conditions and orders they knew about then.
en.他替队友检查扣具，检查完仍抓着绳头。: He checks a teammate's buckles. When he's done, he's still holding the end of the rope.
en.贺鸣：我一松手，就总觉得会出事。但我不能因为怕，就替他们答应所有风险。: He Ming: Every time I let go I think something's about to go wrong. Being scared doesn't give me the right to say yes to every risk for them.
en.贺鸣：我给清楚的范围，你们在范围里判断。遇到停止条件，我也得听。: He Ming: I'll draw the line. Inside it, you make the call. If someone calls a stop, I listen too.
en.授权单留出接受与拒绝的位置，未由本人确认的不算同意。: The form has room for yes and for no. A blank space isn't anyone's consent.
en.贺鸣：那就统一口令，分清岗位。我不越过岗位替人作主。: He Ming: Let's use the same calls and stick to our posts. I won't make somebody else's decisions.
en.你们留下公开指令，不把服从当亲近。: You leave the instructions where everyone can see them. Following an order doesn't make anybody a friend.
en.贺鸣把指挥牌放到桌子中央，没有直接塞给某个人。: He Ming puts the command badge in the middle of the table. He doesn't press it into anyone's hand.
en.贺鸣：谁接，先问本人。接了以后，也得有权说停。: He Ming: Ask who wants to take over. And whoever takes this needs to be able to call a stop.
en.贺鸣：那一次，他们自己判断，也把人接回来了。: He Ming: That time, they made the call. They brought people home.
en.他把绳头放下：我会继续看着，但不会一直攥着。: He puts the end of the rope down. “I'll keep watch. I don't have to keep my fist around it.”
en.贺鸣：我们按程序做事。需要我挡在前面，可以直说。: He Ming: We'll follow procedure. If you need me out in front, just say so.
en.他的职责仍是保护，没有变成接管。: His job is still to protect the crew. The decisions stay with the people doing the work.
en.贺鸣：结束后我去避难所。床铺、走道，都是正经工作。: He Ming: I'm going to the shelter after this. Beds, corridors. That's real work, too.
en.他把次日防护检查做完，才继续写调任申请。: He finishes tomorrow's safety checks before going back to the transfer form.
en.莫遥打开离线日志，没有接上公共投影。: Mo Yao opens her offline log. The public projector stays dark.
en.莫遥：这页能证明当时有人报过警。下面几个名字，证明不了什么，只会让他们被找到。: Mo Yao: This page shows that somebody raised the alarm. Those names underneath prove nothing. They just make it easy to find those people.
en.莫遥：那先分清哪些是技术记录，哪些是私人信息。别一键发出去。: Mo Yao: Let's separate the technical records from people's private details before anybody hits Send.
en.她给两个目录分别加上权限说明。: She marks who can open each folder.
en.莫遥：可以找独立的人核验。原件谁看、看过怎么留痕，先说好。: Mo Yao: Let's get it checked independently. First we agree who sees the original and how we record each visit.
en.你登记授权范围，没有把内部核验当公开许可。: You write down who has permission. Checking a record inside the agency doesn't make it public.
en.她在名单上盖了两张纸，只露出需要核查的时间。: She lays two sheets over the list. Only the times that need checking show through.
en.莫遥：把名字涂黑，别人会说我藏东西。全放出去，承担后果的又不只是我。: Mo Yao: Black out the names and they'll say I'm hiding something. Put it all out there and I won't be the only one who pays for it.
en.莫遥：公开必要的部分，原件受控保存。删掉的原因也写出来。: Mo Yao: Release only what people need. Keep the original under lock and put down a reason for each cut.
en.她逐项核对删节表；声明不是已经完成安全发布的凭据。: She checks the redactions one by one. The public copy still has to go out safely.
en.莫遥：那我保留完整件，技术核查按各自授权进行。: Mo Yao: I'll keep the full copy. Each person can check the technical details they're cleared to see.
en.你们没有把暂不共享解读成背叛。: For now, some things stay private. Neither of you calls that a betrayal.
en.桌上有两份材料：完整封存件和删去身份信息的公开件。: On the table are the sealed original and a public copy with the names removed.
en.莫遥：能确认的说清，不能确认的留白。我不想再靠一份看起来无懈可击的报告。: Mo Yao: Say what we know. Leave a space for what we don't. I've had enough of reports that only look watertight.
en.莫遥：这次范围守住了，能核实的也没有因此少掉。: Mo Yao: We kept the private details private. And people could still check the facts.
en.她把公开稿留下，完整件仍按授权保管。: She leaves the public draft on the desk. The full version stays with its authorized keeper.
en.莫遥：工作信息我会给。别拿熟悉程度替代访问权限。: Mo Yao: I'll share what you need for work. Knowing me doesn't give anyone access to the files.
en.莫遥：救援结束后我会离开这里。技术问题可以联系，私人去向先留给我。: Mo Yao: I'll be leaving after the rescue. You can reach me with technical questions. Where I go is my business for now.
en.她交接值班资料，当前任务照旧。: She hands over the shift records. Her current assignments still stand.
en.江朔把工资账和一张没用上的车票摆在一起。: Jiang Shuo lays the payroll book beside an unused ticket.
en.江朔：那批货送到，大家能拿工资。我选了货。后来家里再打来，说不用赶了。: Jiang Shuo: If the cargo got through, everyone could get paid. I went with the cargo. Later my family called again. Said there was no need to hurry now.
en.江朔：先核工时。谁没收到，谁没签收，不要合成一个总数。: Jiang Shuo: Start with the hours. Who's still waiting to be paid? Who hasn't signed? One total won't tell us that.
en.你们记下待结项目，没有提前写“已清”。: You list the outstanding wages. The space marked “Settled” stays blank.
en.江朔：我不是要你说当时应该选哪边。只是那次再也没有第二班车了。: Jiang Shuo: I'm not asking you to tell me what I should've done. I'm telling you there wasn't another ride after that one.
en.你把账本合上，留他把话说完。: You close the book and give him time to finish.
en.他在船位表上划了一道，划线两侧都是人的名字。: He draws a line across the boat roster. There are names on both sides of it.
en.江朔：总说“再挤一箱”，多出来的工时谁做、谁付，都成了别人的事。: Jiang Shuo: “Squeeze in one more crate.” Who works those extra hours? Who pays for them? Somehow that's always somebody else's problem.
en.江朔：这6资金按具体工资账目结，别写成谁欠谁的人情。后面也别背着当事人改人员优先: Jiang Shuo: Set those six credits against the actual wages. Nobody owes anybody a favor. And if we agree people go first, don't change it behind their backs.
en.收据只证明付款，之后是否违背这项人员优先约定，要到最后核账时一起看。: The receipt shows that the money changed hands. At the final reckoning they'll check whether people really kept their priority.
en.江朔：那先谈能做的范围。不够的钱不空口答应，也不让工人先垫着。: Jiang Shuo: Then let's agree on what we can afford. Don't promise money we haven't got or ask the crew to cover it.
en.你们保留延期说明，没有在未付款的账上盖结清章。: You keep the note on the delay. No one stamps an unpaid bill “Settled.”
en.江朔把账合上，没有把那张车票夹回去。: Jiang Shuo shuts the ledger. He leaves the ticket on the table.
en.江朔：以后要不要留下，我还得跟家里商量。眼前的工钱，先算清。: Jiang Shuo: I'll talk to my family about staying on. First let's settle the wages we owe today.
en.江朔：这笔工钱清了，之后也没有再违背那项人员优先约定。: Jiang Shuo: Those wages are paid. And since then we've kept our word about putting people first.
en.他在工资单上签收，把仍在进行的日常调度留到下一张表。: He signs for the wages. The day-to-day scheduling goes on the next sheet.
en.江朔：以后照约定来。交情之外，工钱和时间照样要算。: Jiang Shuo: We'll go by what we agreed. Friends still need to count the hours and pay the wages.
en.他把公开账贴好，没有再补一句“不计较”。: He posts the accounts for everyone to see. This time he doesn't add, “Don't worry about it.”
en.江朔：这轮结束，我去家人那边住一阵。码头有人接手，我再走。: Jiang Shuo: I'll stay with my family for a while after this. Once someone's here to take my shift, I'll go.
en.调任日期排在最终交接之后。: His transfer is scheduled for after the final handover.
en.林岚：我不想等到看见门落下，才知道已经撤了。: Lin Lan: I don't want to find out we've pulled out by watching the door come down.
en.许舟：那把时点写出来。变更先通知，没收到回执就不能当对方知道。: Xu Zhou: Let's put the times in writing. If the plan changes, call. No reply means you don't know if they heard.
en.林岚：约定写上了，现场还要看是否做到。: Lin Lan: There. It's on paper. We'll see what happens out there.
en.许舟：我不会替你签“已知”。: Xu Zhou: I won't sign “message received” for you.
en.许舟：我们各自负责一段，公共撤离通知照常。: Xu Zhou: We can take separate sections. We'll both get the usual evacuation call.
en.林岚：可以。别把分岗说成赌气。: Lin Lan: Fine. Nobody needs to call it a falling-out.
en.叶禾：你说断了，我还要自己验一次。: Ye He: Even if you say the power's off, I'm checking it myself.
en.陈砚：可以。验之前，我不让你伸手。: Chen Yan: Go ahead. Don't reach in until you've checked.
en.陈砚：断电、复核、再动手。谁都不能省掉中间那一步。: Chen Yan: Cut the power. Check it. Then put your hands in. Nobody skips the middle step.
en.叶禾：我答应的是这个步骤。: Ye He: That's the procedure I'm agreeing to.
en.叶禾：这次分别负责设备，交叉处请独立复核。: Ye He: We'll each take our own equipment. Where our work overlaps, ask someone else to check.
en.陈砚：我会把编号和状态写全。: Chen Yan: I'll put down every number and the state each one's in.
en.许舟：我可以听停止口令，但不是每走一步都等你批准。: Xu Zhou: I'll stop when you say stop. I can't ask permission for every step.
en.贺鸣：那先把你能自行决定的范围说清。: He Ming: Then let's agree what you can decide yourself.
en.贺鸣：范围内你判断，停止条件对我们都有效。: He Ming: Inside those limits, it's your call. The same stop rule goes for both of us.
en.许舟：如果条件变了，先重新确认。: Xu Zhou: If conditions change, we check in again first.
en.许舟：我们分岗，边界上的动作先报。: Xu Zhou: We take separate posts. If I need to cross the line, I'll call first.
en.贺鸣：不把沉默当同意。: He Ming: And silence doesn't mean yes.
en.苏棠：把“江朔忙完再来”改成具体时间吧。: Su Tang: Can we replace “when Jiang Shuo's free” with an actual time?
en.江朔：要是赶不及，我提前找接班，不能让你默认一直等。: Jiang Shuo: If I can't make it, I'll find relief beforehand. I won't just leave you waiting.
en.江朔：下一班是谁、何时接，写进同一张表。: Jiang Shuo: Put the next person's name and the time they take over on the same sheet.
en.苏棠：接应改派另外算资源，不能因为我们熟就空着后勤。: Su Tang: It still takes supplies to move the pickup point. Knowing each other doesn't cover the supply desk.
en.苏棠：今天我只负责这一班。: Su Tang: I'm taking this shift. Just this one.
en.江朔：我按当前职责另排船位。: Jiang Shuo: I'll assign the boat space around the jobs we already have.
en.莫遥：你能证明的是自己签过什么，不是别人为什么没说。: Mo Yao: You know what you signed. You can't know why somebody else kept quiet.
en.陈砚：那把我的陈述和我转述的分两栏。: Chen Yan: Then give me one column for what I saw and another for what I was told.
en.莫遥：每条注明来源，缺的就留空。: Mo Yao: Give each entry a source. Leave gaps where we don't have one.
en.陈砚：原件和修改记录都保留。: Chen Yan: Keep the originals and every change.
en.陈砚：材料先封存，等能核实的人来。: Chen Yan: Seal it for now, until somebody who knows can check it.
en.莫遥：不急着拼成完整故事。: Mo Yao: We can live with an incomplete story.
en.林岚：你怎么又在最后一班？: Lin Lan: How did you end up on the last shift again?
en.苏棠：你名字也在。我们俩都说“我可以”，表就永远不用改。: Su Tang: You're on it too. If we both keep saying “I can,” nobody ever has to change the roster.
en.林岚：先问接班的人愿不愿意，再排轮换。: Lin Lan: Let's ask who's willing to relieve us before we put their name down.
en.苏棠：今天的休息，谁也不替谁取消。: Su Tang: And neither of us gets to cancel the other's break today.
en.苏棠：各自把下班时间说清吧。: Su Tang: Let's each put down when we're clocking off.
en.林岚：互相提醒，但不代替对方答应。: Lin Lan: We can remind each other. We can't say yes for each other.
en.叶禾：删掉名字以后，怎么知道你没改别的？: Ye He: Once the names are gone, how can I tell what else you've changed?
en.莫遥：公开件删身份，原件交受授权的人核对，改过哪里另列一张表。: Mo Yao: I'll take identities out of the public copy. Someone cleared to see the original can check it against a list of every cut.
en.叶禾：我能核对变化，就不需要把所有名字公开。: Ye He: If I can check the changes, I don't need everybody's name made public.
en.莫遥：授权也要记下来。: Mo Yao: Put down who gave permission, too.
en.莫遥：你查你的材料，我守我的授权范围。: Mo Yao: Check the material you have. I'll stay within the permission I've got.
en.叶禾：能交换的技术事实，写明来源。: Ye He: Then let's put a source beside the technical details we can share.
en.贺鸣：那个位置危险，我想直接把人抱走。: He Ming: They're exposed there. I want to pick them up and run.
en.林岚：先听伤情判断。快一点，可能反而让人撑不到出口。: Lin Lan: Let me check their injuries. Move too fast and they might not make it to the exit.
en.贺鸣：搬运照你的医疗判断，危险变化我及时报。: He Ming: You tell me how to carry them. I'll tell you when the danger changes.
en.林岚：我也会说清什么时候必须撤。: Lin Lan: And I'll tell you when we have to leave.
en.林岚：每次由当班医疗人员判断。: Lin Lan: Let the medic on duty make that call each time.
en.贺鸣：保护不等于把决定权拿走。: He Ming: My job's to keep them safe. The decision doesn't have to be mine.
en.江朔：这箱一起带？: Jiang Shuo: Room for this crate, too?
en.许舟：先说重量，还有谁来接。别把“顺路”写成没有成本。: Xu Zhou: How heavy, and who's meeting us? “On our way” doesn't mean it costs nothing.
en.江朔：要改任务，先问执行的人。不同意就不加。: Jiang Shuo: Ask the people carrying it before we change the job. If they say no, it stays.
en.许舟：我答应哪一段，就负责哪一段。: Xu Zhou: Tell me which stretch is mine. That's the stretch I'll cover.
en.许舟：这次按原清单走。: Xu Zhou: We'll go with the original list this time.
en.江朔：多的留下登记，不能偷偷塞上船。: Jiang Shuo: Log the rest here. No slipping it aboard.
en.苏棠：这条记录写“无人响应”，可当时设备已经断电了。: Su Tang: It says “no answer.” By then the power was already out.
en.莫遥：我只能证明断电时点，之前几通还得查。: Mo Yao: I can tell you when the power went. The earlier calls still need checking.
en.莫遥：已知、未知分开。接应也只能按已确认的信息排。: Mo Yao: Keep what we know apart from what we don't. We can only plan the pickup around what's confirmed.
en.苏棠：那先别把空白填成谁的错。: Su Tang: So let's leave the blank spaces alone. They aren't anybody's fault yet.
en.苏棠：今晚先停在这里，我需要睡觉。: Su Tang: Let's stop there for tonight. I need some sleep.
en.莫遥：原件留着，不会因为晚查一天就替你下结论。: Mo Yao: I'll keep the original. Another day won't make me decide what happened for you.
en.贺鸣：我还要知道今晚出了问题叫谁。: He Ming: I still need a name to call if it goes wrong tonight.
en.陈砚：负责人、交接时间、停止条件都写上。: Chen Yan: I'll put down who's responsible, when the shift changes and when to stop.
en.贺鸣：值班的人确认后，这次交接才算成立。: He Ming: Once the person on duty confirms, we've handed it over.
en.贺鸣：本次维修先交清，后面的班另排。: He Ming: Let's sign off on this repair. We'll staff the later shifts separately.
en.陈砚：不签自己承担不了的期限。: Chen Yan: I won't sign up for hours I can't cover.
en.叶禾：箱子上有名字。公用，不等于谁都能拿。: Ye He: There's a name on that box. Being on the same crew doesn't make it yours.
en.江朔：问过本人再借，归还时照清单点。: Jiang Shuo: Ask before borrowing. Count it all back in against the list.
en.江朔：用途、归还时间说清，对方可以不同意。: Jiang Shuo: Tell them what it's for and when it'll be back. They can still say no.
en.叶禾：也别借着检查把私人物件翻出来。: Ye He: And checking a toolbox doesn't give us a right to go through someone's things.
en.叶禾：那就用公共基础工具。: Ye He: Then we'll use the basic tools in the common kit.
en.江朔：慢一点可以算，未经同意不能算成省事。: Jiang Shuo: We can allow time for that. Borrowing without asking isn't a shortcut.
en.林岚尝了尝汤，把盐罐又放回去：“今天先这样，明天还可以调。”: Lin Lan tastes the soup and puts the salt back. “That'll do today. There's always tomorrow.”
en.林岚：我盛进保温杯，写上是谁的，别让人以为又是必须加班的暗号。: Lin Lan: I'll put names on the flasks. A bowl of soup shouldn't be code for another shift.
en.林岚：好，凉了就不好喝了。夜班那份我另留。: Lin Lan: Good. Drink it while it's hot. I'll save some for the night crew.
en.许舟压低声音模仿天气播报，最后一句夹着收音机的底噪。: Xu Zhou drops his voice into a weather announcer's register. Static crackles through his sign-off.
en.许舟：后面还有广告——算了，广告明天再演。: Xu Zhou: And now for the ads! Actually, let's save those for tomorrow.
en.许舟：收到，本台现在进入静音时段。他笑着关了电台。: Xu Zhou: Copy that. This station is now observing radio silence. He grins and turns it off.
en.苏棠拿着一叠标签：“这个杯子已经有三个外号了，今天得有一个身份证。”: Su Tang fans out a stack of labels. “This mug's got three nicknames. Time it had some ID.”
en.苏棠：你写名字，我贴。别把贺鸣的针线盒写成急救包。: Su Tang: You write, I'll stick. Try not to label He Ming's sewing kit as first aid.
en.苏棠：行，旧名也能查到人就够了。她在标签背面记下对应关系。: Su Tang: Fine, keep the old names if they get it back to the right person. She writes them on the back.
en.陈砚的饭盒底垫着一块抹布。他说封圈只差一点，汤还是漏了一滴。: Chen Yan's lunch tin sits on a rag. “Seal's nearly right.” A single drop of soup escapes.
en.陈砚：这次先用新的。旧圈留给我量尺寸，别留给下一顿饭。: Chen Yan: New seal for lunch today. Give me the old one to measure. No need to test it on dinner.
en.陈砚：那我把没漏的那格分出来。下次带个真的不漏的。: Chen Yan: Here, we can split the side that didn't leak. Next time I'll bring one that really holds.
en.叶禾蹲着系亮色鞋带。泥已经溅到鞋面，鞋结仍很整齐。: Ye He crouches to tie her bright laces. Mud spatters the shoes, but the bows are neat.
en.叶禾：怕找不到自己的鞋。后来发现大家都记得了，只有我还在找。: Ye He: I picked them so I could find my shoes. Now everybody remembers which are mine except me.
en.叶禾：这双还结实，补好比换新舒服。颜色不配也没关系。: Ye He: The shoes are still good. Patched ones feel better than new ones. Who cares if the colors match?
en.贺鸣看着一段舞蹈录像，脚步总在同一个地方慢半拍。: He Ming follows a dance video. The same step catches him half a beat late every time.
en.贺鸣：你站前面，我跟着来。别笑——算了，笑也行。: He Ming: Get in front and I'll follow. Don't laugh. Oh, go on, you can laugh.
en.贺鸣：拍上半段吧。后半段我练好了再发，不假装已经会了。: He Ming: Film the first half. I'll send the rest when I can do it. No point faking it.
en.莫遥翻着旧街区照片，一块褪色广告牌占了半张画面。: Mo Yao turns over a photograph of the old neighborhood. A faded sign fills half the frame.
en.莫遥：不是拍广告，是拍下面那层旧字。每换一家店，都露出来一点。: Mo Yao: I wanted the old lettering underneath. Every time the shop changes hands, another bit shows through.
en.莫遥：这家以前卖早点。我只记得味道，不敢说是哪一年搬走的。: Mo Yao: They used to sell breakfast there. I remember the taste. Couldn't tell you the year they moved.
en.江朔在纸上写船名，最长的一个已经占了两行。: Jiang Shuo writes down names for boats. The longest one already takes two lines.
en.江朔：那就写船头，报无线电时还是用短号。不然一句话就把频道占满了。: Jiang Shuo: Paint it on the bow, then. On the radio we'll use the short call sign. I'd tie up the whole channel saying that.
en.江朔：短的好。长名留给私下叫，没人会认错船。: Jiang Shuo: Short is good. Use the long name among ourselves and nobody gets the wrong boat.
en.林岚对着一张没有用量的食谱皱眉：“少许，比适量还难办。”: Lin Lan frowns at the recipe. “A pinch? That's worse than ‘to taste.’”
en.林岚：先做一小锅。不好吃也不能因为怀念就逼大家吃完。: Lin Lan: Let's try one small pot. Just because I miss it doesn't mean everybody has to finish it.
en.林岚：承认了。今晚换一道能做好的，食谱留着。: Lin Lan: All right, I admit it. Tonight I'll make something I know how to cook. We'll keep the recipe.
en.许舟把一杯咖啡放下：“你以前是不是这样喝？”: Xu Zhou sets down a coffee. “Is this how you used to take it?”
en.许舟：记住一杯咖啡，比记住三十个频道容易。: Xu Zhou: One coffee's easier to remember than thirty frequencies.
en.许舟：那我重新记。人又不是设好就不能改的电台。: Xu Zhou: Then I'll learn it again. People don't come with preset stations.
en.苏棠把白布挂到屋顶，风一吹，片头也跟着晃。: Su Tang hangs a sheet on the roof. A gust of wind makes the opening credits ripple.
en.苏棠：挑个不漏雨的位置。看不完也可以先走，没人点名。: Su Tang: Pick a dry spot. Go home halfway through if you like. Nobody's taking attendance.
en.苏棠：给你留安静房间。好笑的段落明天再讲，你想听再讲。: Su Tang: There's a quiet room for you. Tomorrow I can tell you the funny bits, if you feel like hearing them.
en.陈砚把小盆栽往光里挪，桌上留下一圈湿痕。: Chen Yan moves a little plant into the light. A damp ring stays behind on the desk.
en.陈砚：这里正好，不挡过道。我把托盘也擦干。: Chen Yan: Good spot. It's clear of the walkway. Let me dry the saucer too.
en.陈砚：那我写下浇水次数。别因为是我的东西，就非得等我才照顾。: Chen Yan: I'll write down how often it wants water. You don't have to wait for me just because it's mine.
en.叶禾拧好最后一颗小螺丝，玩具发出有些走调的声音。: Ye He tightens the last tiny screw. The toy chimes, just a little flat.
en.叶禾：能用就先送回去。要是不喜欢这个声音，我们再改。: Ye He: If it works, let's give it back. If they don't like the sound, we can tune it.
en.叶禾：写大一点，还得画图。别拿维修术语考小孩。: Ye He: Big letters. Pictures too. A kid shouldn't need a repair manual to understand us.
en.贺鸣穿了三次针，终于把线穿进去：“这个比扣具难。”: He Ming threads the needle on his third try. “Buckles are easier.”
en.贺鸣：看得见也好，下次就知道哪里补过。: He Ming: Let the patch show. Next time we'll know where we mended it.
en.贺鸣：结实就行。漂亮的针脚我以后再练。: He Ming: As long as it holds. I can work on pretty stitches later.
en.莫遥摸了两个口袋，又回头看刚锁上的门。: Mo Yao pats both pockets and looks back at the door she just locked.
en.莫遥：备用钥匙要登记借还。不能因为我常忘，就让谁都能进。: Mo Yao: Sign the spare key out and back in. Just because I'm forgetful doesn't mean everyone should be able to get in.
en.莫遥：那就等。我去门边坐着，至少这次不会再走丢。: Mo Yao: Then we'll wait. I'll sit by the door. At least you won't lose me this time.
en.江朔把甜点切成不太均匀的几块：“大的那块不代表职位高。”: Jiang Shuo cuts the dessert into uneven pieces. “The biggest one doesn't go by rank.”
en.江朔：按班留好，别让晚回来的人只剩盒子。: Jiang Shuo: Save some for each shift. Nobody wants to get back late and find an empty box.
en.江朔：这盒写上名字。公用那份我另分，不从别人那份里扣。: Jiang Shuo: Put a name on this box. I'll divide up the shared portion separately so nobody loses their piece.
en.苏棠给自己倒了一杯温水，没戴耳机。: Su Tang pours herself a glass of warm water. Her headset stays off.
en.苏棠：坐吧。今天可以不找话说。: Su Tang: Sit down. We don't have to talk today.
en.苏棠：谢谢。半小时后如果灯还亮着，也不用进来叫我工作。: Su Tang: Thanks. If my light's still on in half an hour, you can leave me be.
en.林岚站在门口看天，袖口终于干了。: Lin Lan stands in the doorway looking at the sky. Her cuffs have finally dried.
en.林岚：以后我想种点能吃的东西。先从不容易死的开始。: Lin Lan: I'd like to grow something we can eat. Start with something hard to kill.
en.林岚：那先解决今晚。汤里加面，算一道新菜。: Lin Lan: Let's sort out tonight first. Noodles in the soup. There, a whole new dish.
en.码头联络员把已交接名单贴到干燥的墙面：上岸的先登记，没接上的另列，不能混成一个总: The dock liaison finds a dry patch of wall for the list. One column for people who made it ashore. Another for anyone still waiting.
en.接上的名单先交给接驳点；余下位置已经转给下一轮调度，不把仍在等待的人写成获救。: The transfer desk gets the confirmed names first. Anyone still waiting stays on the next crew's list.
en.本轮接驳没完成。我们会转交最后已知位置，但今天没带回来的人，不会出现在签收栏。: The pickup fell short. The next crew gets the last known locations. The clerk signs only for people who made it back.
en.诊所把可以供电的设备分到同一张值班表，仍按实际可用容量开机。: The clinic puts the equipment it can power on a single rota. Nobody plugs in more than the line can take.
en.诊所先用已能工作的部分，其他床位继续人工安排。备用件是否带回，另按实物登记。: The clinic opens the sections it can use and assigns the remaining beds by hand. The spare parts have their own inventory sheet.
en.诊所改用轮流照明和人工值守。缺电的区域仍留着警示灯，下一班接过了这张值班表。: The clinic takes turns with the lights and sets a watch by hand. Warning lamps mark the dark sections. The next shift takes the roster.
en.仓库开始按签收清单出借工具，取回的和仍在里面的分成两页。: The warehouse starts lending tools. What's back on the shelf goes on one page. What's still inside goes on another.
en.已交回的工具先上架，缺项仍标红；基础工具照常借，不要求每支队伍先买齐。: The clerk shelves what came back and marks the gaps in red. Crews can still borrow the basic tools.
en.库门和货单交给接班的人。公共工具照常出借，这批物资只按实际送到的签收。: The next crew takes the keys and the manifest. The basic tools are still available. The clerk signs for what actually came back.
en.桥下的维修记录交给道路值班员，通行仍按实际加固段划定。: The bridge crew hands its notes to the road watch. Traffic can go only as far as the reinforcements hold.
en.已处理的桥段先标明，没完成的地方保留封控；工人的去向另按救援记录核对。: The crew marks the sections it finished. The cordons stay up elsewhere. The worker's handover has its own entry.
en.桥下作业暂停，绕行标识补到路口。联络员继续核对最后的位置和已经收到的交接单。: Work below the bridge stops. Detour signs go up at the junctions. The liaison checks the last known positions against the slips in hand.
en.泵房值班员接过已完成的操作记录：这轮能做的写清，后面的值守另排。: The pump operator takes the work log and reads down the finished jobs. The watch roster for the next shift is still to be filled.
en.泵房使用已安全确认的部分，未完成项继续封存；模块交回与否按清单结算。: Only the sections cleared as safe are in use. The rest stay sealed. The module gets its own entry on the returns sheet.
en.泵房这一轮没能接管。附近居民收到新的积水提示，后续任务按变坏的现场继续。: Nobody can take over the pump room yet. Nearby households get a fresh flood warning. The next crew will face the water left behind.
en.第一轮涨潮后，登记处把每一个实际撤回的人写进接驳单。档案箱另页登记。: After the first tide, the clerk writes down each person who made it back. The archive crate goes on a separate page.
en.登记处同时留下撤回名单和未完成事项，没有用“差不多都回来了”合并掉缺项。: The clerk keeps the names and the outstanding jobs side by side. “Nearly everyone” won't do for a head count.
en.这一轮未达到撤离目标。接管名单已经移交，未被救出的事实仍保留。: The evacuation fell short. The receiving team has the list, including the names still awaiting handover.
en.工地联络员把线路状态和人员交接分别签收，工具箱上的名字仍归原主。: The site liaison signs once for the lines and once for the people brought back. The toolbox still bears its owner's name.
en.能确认的线路与人员状态先交接，序号查不到的部分继续留空。: The crew hands over the line and personnel details it could confirm. Any missing serial numbers stay blank.
en.工地保留警戒与失联记录。工具箱不会因为任务结束就自动回到主人手中。: The site stays under watch. Missing people remain on the register. A name on a toolbox doesn't say where its owner is.
en.补给线按已确认的路段恢复调度，备用绕行是否核验另看记录。: Dispatch sends the convoy down the cleared stretch. The alternate route has its own entry on the map.
en.车队只走已确认安全的部分，未清开的障碍继续挂在调度板上。: The convoy sticks to the sections cleared as safe. The remaining obstacles stay on the dispatch board.
en.车队停止走这条补给线。额外绕行和等待会留到后续安排里，今天不虚报到货。: The convoy stops using this road. Dispatch pencils in a detour and a delay, and leaves today's arrival time blank.
en.病房交接以实际送达的人为准，药箱按另单入库。值班员逐项核完才签字。: The ward signs for the patients who arrived. Medical equipment goes on a separate sheet. The duty clerk checks each line.
en.送达的病人先安置；尚未完成的转运另列，不把稳定过误写成已经送达。: The ward makes room for those who arrived. A patient stabilized on the roof stays on the transfer list until the handover.
en.屋顶病房本轮转运未完成。接收点留下已经到岸者的记录，其余联络从最后确认的位置继续: The roof transfer fell short. The ward keeps the names of anyone who arrived and the last known positions of those who didn't.
en.预案的实测步骤归入值班手册；是否开放额外接应口，只看现场两岗是否真正完成。: The tested steps go into the duty manual. There's a separate record of whether both posts worked long enough to open another pickup point.
en.完成的测试先保留，没验证的流程标成待测，不印成可直接照做的预案。: The team keeps the drill results and marks the untested steps in pencil. Those pages aren't ready to issue.
en.预案暂不作为已验证方案使用。普通撤离路线仍在，下一班不必照抄失败步骤。: The new plan goes back for testing. The ordinary evacuation routes are still there for the next shift.
en.门禁与已取得资料分别签收。打开门不等于可以任意公开门后的内容。: The crew signs separately for the door and for the papers it brought out. Opening the door doesn't make the files public.
en.能确认的操作先记，没取到的资料不由转述补齐。: The crew logs what it actually did. No one fills in a missing document from memory.
en.门禁的活没交清。联络员逐项核对带回的资料，后续查阅仍走原来的渠道。: The door job fell short. The clerk checks the materials register for what actually came back. Further requests go through the usual channels.
en.备份交接单列出实际拿到的载体，缺失时段保持缺失。: The backup clerk signs only for the media in hand. The gaps on the timeline remain.
en.已保存的片段单独封存，不能因为片段真实就说整份记录完整。: The clerk seals the recovered fragments individually. A genuine fragment can still be part of an incomplete record.
en.这轮没有完成所需交接。登记员把已收到的载体另行封存，未交接的栏位仍留空。: The handover fell short. The clerk seals what arrived and leaves the missing items' spaces blank.
en.日志进入受控核查目录。原始记录与解释分开，谁说过什么各有来源。: The log goes into the restricted files. Each account keeps its source, with the original entry separate from anyone's reading of it.
en.已取得的日志先封存，尚未取得的页码写缺失，不靠人物猜测补上。: The crew seals the pages it has and lists the missing numbers. Nobody tries to reconstruct the gaps from a guess.
en.日志未能按目标交接。公共核查仍有后续窗口，今天没有的新事实不进入归责。: The log handover fell short. The review stays open. Nobody is named responsible on the strength of a missing page.
en.冷库按实际恢复状态排班，药品逐箱签收；账页是否取得另列。: The cold store rosters staff for the sections in working order. Medicines are signed in by the box. The ledger is a separate item.
en.库管清点手边的药箱，再核对哪一段冷柜还能用。保住多少，就签收多少。: The clerk counts the medicines in hand and notes which refrigeration is running. Only stock actually preserved goes in the total.
en.冷库的主要任务未能完成。病区重新核对库存；本轮实际送达的药品单独签收，尚未交接的: The cold store missed its main goal. The ward recounts the shelves, signing for the boxes that arrived and listing those still missing.
en.接线员按实际送达名单销掉求援条，其余条目仍在，不能用任务成功替代每一户的结果。: The dispatcher crosses off each household that reached safety. The calls still waiting stay on the pad.
en.接到的人先安排，未接到的求援转交下一轮。没有人需要先证明“更值得救”。: The people already here get places first. The next shift takes the outstanding calls. Nobody has to make a case for being worth rescuing.
en.三个地址的求援还没交清。接线员把已送达的名字和待接应的求援条分开，留给下一班。: The calls haven't all been cleared. The next dispatcher gets two lists: confirmed arrivals and households still waiting for a handover.
en.码头按人员和货物分别签收。腾出的空间如何分配，原来的选择仍留在记录里。: At the dock, people and cargo have separate sign-in sheets. The manifest still shows who got each space.
en.送达部分先交接，余下船位缺口交给下一班；货运补助只按真正到岸的货物核发。: The dock hands over what arrived and passes the shortfall on to the next shift. The cargo allowance covers only what came ashore.
en.这次船位安排没达成目标。人员结果与货物损失分别登记，不能拿一箱货抵消一个人的去向: The boat assignment fell short. The dock logs people and cargo separately. A crate can't account for a missing person.
en.泵房接管员接收本次明确选择的方案；修复与隔离的结果不混写。: The pump-room operator takes the crew's chosen plan. The log distinguishes repaired equipment from branches sealed off.
en.已做的安全处置保留，尚未完成的最终方案不提前挂上“恢复”牌。: The safety work already done stays in place. The operator leaves the final handover unsigned until the chosen plan is complete.
en.泵房本轮没有完成可交接方案。现场按未恢复状态封控，旧问题继续影响街区。: The pump room isn't ready for handover. It stays cordoned off, and the district still has the old problem to deal with.
en.广播站保留实际完成的播发记录。备份是否取得另记，不能靠听到广播推定档案完整。: The station keeps the transmission log and checks the backup separately. Receiving a broadcast says nothing about the archive.
en.确认过的播发和中继步骤先登记，没完成的内容留给后续接管。: The station records the broadcast and relay work it can confirm. The next shift takes over the unfinished steps.
en.广播目标未完成，通知改经现有联络网络分发。值班人将已确认和仍待接通的频道分开标记: The broadcast fell short. The watch sends the notice through existing contacts and marks which channels have yet to answer.
en.病房、避难点和设备各用一张交接单，谁送达、哪里能用逐项核对。: The ward, the shelter and the equipment store each get a slip. The clerk checks who delivered what and where it can be used.
en.先使用已交接的部分，未搬出的设备不记进后续库存。: The crew starts with what came through the handover. Equipment still on site stays off the store's inventory.
en.警戒水位前的任务未完成。病区按当前资源重排，失败不会清除已经保住的旧成果。: The crew ran out of time before the water reached the warning mark. The ward reschedules with what it has, including what earlier crews saved.
en.床位板上，东西两所各有一栏。哪一处交了工，哪一栏才开始填名字。: Each shelter has its own entry on the bed board. Dispatch can use every section the crews actually finished.
en.两处避难所各自登记。值班员拿着清单，只把床位分到已经能住人的地方。: Each shelter has its own line. Dispatch assigns beds only in the finished sections.
en.本轮避难所目标未完成。后续按现有床位分流，不能把规划里的床算成已能使用。: The shelter work fell short. Dispatch works down the list of beds already available. The planned beds will have to wait.
en.道路联络员接过实测路线；现场接应是否持续值守达标另看交班记录。: The road liaison takes the route the crew checked. The shift log shows separately whether anyone kept the pickup post staffed.
en.能走的段落先公布，未完成的路标和接应能力不混进开放说明。: The liaison posts the stretches that are open. Unfinished markers and unconfirmed pickup points stay off the notice.
en.路线目标未完成，码头沿现有通道安排；新出口不会因经过一次就自动开放。: The route fell short. The dock uses its existing corridors. A single trip through a new exit doesn't open it for general use.
en.交接材料列出可公开范围，私密原件按授权保管。摘要公开与否不改变已经取得的技术证据: The handover lists what can go public. Private originals stay with their authorized keepers. The technical evidence is retained either way.
en.已交接的部分先封存，隐私处理没完成的部分不自动公开。: The crew seals what it handed over. Anything still awaiting a privacy check stays under its existing restrictions.
en.最终交接未达目标。现有证据按原权限保留，不为了补结果把全部私人信息放出去。: The final handover fell short. Access to the evidence stays as agreed. Nobody releases private records to fill the gaps.
en.最终转运名单只列实际送达者，重建物资另单签收。谁先谁后仍能从记录中看见。: The final transport list records who arrived and in what order. Reconstruction supplies are signed in separately.
en.码头签收已经上岸的人，库房另行清点重建箱。两张单子各自留着要补的地方。: The transport desk signs for the people who arrived. The store checks the reconstruction crate separately. Each desk keeps its own list of gaps.
en.本轮撤离顺序未能完成目标。余下缺口带入最后部署，最后一天仍可继续选择可用路线。: The evacuation fell short. The remaining gaps carry into the last deployment. The crew can still choose among the routes available.
en.最后的值班记录封存。窗外天色渐亮，登记员将这一轮的交接单和各人的去向分开放好。: Daylight reaches the window as the registrar seals the last duty log. The handover slips go in one pile, the crew's destinations in another.
en.最后的交接只完成了一部分。值班人把已经保住的成果写进正页，仍待处理的事项留在另一: The final handover is incomplete. The duty clerk records what the crew saved and leaves a second sheet for the work still waiting.
en.最终方案未能实现，事务所转入撤离与交接。值班人合上今天的记录，将尚未完成的事项留: The final plan fell through. The agency turns to evacuation and handover. The clerk closes the log and leaves the unfinished jobs for the people taking over.
en.仓库在货架边挂起签收表，取回的那批物资有了去处。: The warehouse hangs a receipt sheet beside the shelves. The shipment the crew brought back has somewhere to go.
en.签收表还空着这一批货的位置，仓库按现有库存继续登记。: The shipment's line is blank. The warehouse keeps issuing supplies from the stock it has.
en.维修员的交接记录随获救名单一起送到道路值班处。: The road watch gets the maintenance worker's handover slip with the list of people brought back.
en.道路值班处尚未收到这名工人的到岸确认，登记员保留着最后联络的位置。: The road watch hasn't had word that the worker made it ashore. The clerk keeps the last known contact point on file.
en.第一张撤回名单上有了这个人的名字，登记员把对应求援条订在背后。: The first evacuation list bears this resident's name. The clerk staples the matching call for help to the back of the list.
en.这名居民没有出现在撤回名单上，求援条仍留在待交接的一页。: This resident's name is missing from the evacuation list. The call for help stays on the pending page.
en.档案箱签收后单独封存，没有因为拿到了箱子就宣布内容全部属实。: The archive crate is signed in and sealed. Someone still has to check what's inside.
en.档案箱没有保全，封存目录里留着空号；其他渠道送来的证据仍分别登记。: There's an empty slot in the sealed inventory where the archive crate should be. Evidence from other sources keeps its own entries.
en.车队按实际恢复的运输路线登记班次。: Dispatch schedules the convoy along the supply route the crew restored.
en.这条运输线没有如期交接，调度员在图上保留了绕行标记。: The road wasn't handed over in time. Dispatch leaves the detour on the map.
en.屋顶转运的这名病人进入接收名单，后续医疗由接收点安排。: The patient from the rooftop ward is on the intake list. The receiving team takes over their care.
en.接收名单里还缺这名病人的确认，登记员继续核对屋顶的最后位置。: The intake list still has no confirmation for this patient. The clerk checks the last known location on the roof.
en.演练记录归入预案，未演练的动作仍标为未验证。: The drill results go into the plan. Untested steps keep their pencil marks.
en.预案中这一项仍留着“待验证”的标记，值班人没有在旁边签名。: This step still reads “untested.” The space beside it for the duty officer's signature is blank.
en.已取得的那页记录登记为证据来源，空缺处仍未补齐。: The recovered page goes on the evidence list. The gaps in it are still gaps.
en.那页材料尚未取得，缺失签名的栏位仍空着。: Nobody has brought that page in. The space for the missing signature stays blank.
en.药品按实际交回数量登记，后续库存沿用结算结果。: The ward signs the medicines into stock by the quantity that actually arrived.
en.药品签收表里缺了这一批，病区先按现有库存安排。: This batch is missing from the receipt sheet. The ward plans around what's already on the shelves.
en.东侧住户的名字进入已接收名单，其余两户分别结算。: The household from the east building goes on the arrivals list. The two other addresses have their own entries.
en.东侧住户没有完成到岸交接，登记员将这一户与另两户分开记录。: There's no shore handover for the east building. The clerk keeps that household's entry separate from the other two.
en.实际到岸的人先交接，货物和工钱仍另页核算。: The dock takes charge of the people who made it ashore. Cargo and wages go on another sheet.
en.对应人员没有完成上岸交接，码头留下这张尚未签收的名单。: The dock has no handover for the passengers on this list. The signature line stays empty.
en.泵房按修复方案移交，后续仍需维护，不承诺永远不会再坏。: The crew hands the pump room over under the repair plan. The next shift will still have maintenance to do.
en.最终修复尚未完成，泵房的移交栏仍留着“未恢复”的标记。: The final repair is incomplete. The handover board still reads “out of service.”
en.广播的完成记录存入电台日志；谁听见，仍以各自知情记录为准。: The station logs the completed broadcast. Who actually heard it is a separate question.
en.这次广播没有完成，通知转交现有联络网络，播发日志上没有补签。: The broadcast didn't finish. The watch passes the notice along the existing network and leaves the station log unsigned.
en.最后病房的病人进入接收流程，相关设备是否取回另看记录。: The receiving team takes the ward's patient into its care. It checks the equipment against a separate record.
en.这名病人没有完成转运，接收点保留最后确认的位置。: The patient didn't reach the receiving team. The staff keep the last confirmed location on file.
en.东侧避难所开始安排床位。西侧是否开放，看它自己的交接单。: Dispatch starts assigning beds in the east shelter. The west shelter has its own handover sheet.
en.东侧避难所尚未启用，调度员按现有床位继续安排。: The east shelter hasn't opened. Dispatch keeps assigning people to the beds it already has.
en.已验证的通道写进码头路线图，额外出口仍看独立值守结果。: The verified corridor goes on the dock map. Extra exits still depend on the separate watch log.
en.这条通道没有完成交接，路线图上仍沿用原来的标记。: The corridor wasn't handed over. The dock keeps the old markings on the map.
en.公开材料按既定范围删去身份信息，受控原件仍供授权核验。: The public copy has identifying details removed. Authorized reviewers can still check it against the original.
en.材料的隐私处理尚未完成，原件仍按现有权限保管。: The privacy check isn't finished. The original stays under the existing access rules.
en.重建箱入库后按实物分配；这份资源不等于城市已经重建完毕。: The reconstruction crate goes into stock. The depot can issue what's inside. Rebuilding the city will take more than one shipment.
en.重建箱没有完成入库，工具分配表里没有填上这一批。: The reconstruction crate hasn't reached the depot. The tool allocation sheet has no entry for it.
en.这次没能见面，双方没有订下新约定。: They didn't get to meet. No new agreement was made.
en.这段交谈已归档，当时没有作出回应。: This conversation is on file. No reply was recorded at the time.
en.回到营地后，可以继续这次交谈。: You can pick up this conversation back at camp.
en.最迟第 %d 晚约定: Had to be agreed by night %d
en.这段心事，你们没来得及谈完。: There were things you never got to finish talking about.
en.无法继续这个自动存档，可恢复备份或选择其他周目。: This autosave couldn't be loaded. Restore a backup or choose another campaign.
en.当前没有可读取的周目。: No campaigns are available to load.
en.查看队员的结局: See what happens to the crew
en.M10、M21 的其他出口需要完成现场操作。: In M10 and M21, complete the field operation to open an extra exit.
en.这项功能今晚没有可执行的安排。: There’s nothing to do here tonight.
en.公益修复 · 仅记入社区后记: Repair for the community epilogue only
en.先选定明天的路线，再结束今晚。: Choose a route for tomorrow before turning in.
en.搬起目标后直接移动，预览会显示这次能走到哪里。: Pick up the target, then preview a move to see how far you can carry it.
en.苏棠：那两次后勤都没再默认填上我的名字。: Su Tang: Those two shifts went by without my name slipping back onto the rota.
en.叶禾把今天的记录放在旧复印件旁，来回看了两眼，两份都留在桌上。: Ye He lays today's notes beside the old photocopy. Her eyes travel from one to the other. Both stay on the table.
en.许舟：收到，本台现在进入静音时段。: Xu Zhou: Copy that. This station is now observing radio silence.
en.他笑着关了电台。: He grins and turns off the radio.
en.苏棠：行，旧名也能查到人就够了。: Su Tang: Fine. Keep the old names if they get it back to the right person.
en.她在标签背面记下对应关系。: She writes the old names on the back of the label.
en.林岚的信上先问诊所是否还有干纱布，随后写道：医生让我先把自己的手养好。值班请另排: Lin Lan's first question is whether the clinic still has dry gauze. “Doctor's orders. I need to let my hands heal. Give my shifts to someone else for now.”
en.许舟来信说，新船队的事暂缓了。他正学着把康复练习按时做完，而不是偷偷加量。: Xu Zhou writes that joining a new boat crew will have to wait. He's learning to do his exercises on time without sneaking in extra sets.
en.苏棠的消息由病区公共终端发来：不用替我保留耳机。我现在需要安静，工作记录已经交接: A message from Su Tang comes through the ward terminal. “Don't keep my headset for me. I need some quiet. I've handed over the logs.”
en.陈砚托人送回保养记录：康复期间无法到现场，哪些设备由谁接手，请重新签认。: Chen Yan sends back the maintenance log. “I can't be on site while I'm recovering. Get a new signature for each piece of equipment so everyone knows who's taken over.”
en.叶禾的信里夹着一份设备交接表：我暂时回不来。工具可以借，个人那份复印件替我锁好。: Ye He encloses an equipment list. “I won't be back for a while. Lend out the tools if anyone needs them. Lock up my copy of the records, though.”
en.贺鸣请人转告：以后不要照着我的旧站位硬顶。现场已经变了，交给新的值班负责人。: He Ming sends word. “Don't dig in just because that's where I used to stand. Things have changed out there. Let the new shift lead make the call.”
en.莫遥的消息只有简短授权清单：我暂时无法核验新材料。超出这张清单的内容，请重新联系: Mo Yao sends a short list of permissions. “I can't verify anything new right now. For anything beyond this list, ask the people involved again.”
en.江朔托合作社送来账册：康复安排还没定，下一班请另选负责人。没付的项目继续挂账，别: The co-op brings Jiang Shuo's ledger. “No date yet for rehab. Pick someone else for the next shift. Leave the unpaid wages on the books for me.”
en.值班簿记下：林岚和许舟这次没能同席。这项协商暂时留空，原有职责仍按已经确认的安排: The duty log says Lin Lan and Xu Zhou couldn't meet. Their agreement stays open. The next shift follows the arrangements already in place.
en.值班簿记下：陈砚和叶禾这次没能同席。这项协商暂时留空，原有职责仍按已经确认的安排: The duty log says Chen Yan and Ye He couldn't meet. Their agreement stays open. The next shift follows the arrangements already in place.
en.值班簿记下：许舟和贺鸣这次没能同席。这项协商暂时留空，原有职责仍按已经确认的安排: The duty log says Xu Zhou and He Ming couldn't meet. Their agreement stays open. The next shift follows the arrangements already in place.
en.值班簿记下：苏棠和江朔这次没能同席。这项协商暂时留空，原有职责仍按已经确认的安排: The duty log says Su Tang and Jiang Shuo couldn't meet. Their agreement stays open. The next shift follows the arrangements already in place.
en.值班簿记下：莫遥和陈砚这次没能同席。这项协商暂时留空，原有职责仍按已经确认的安排: The duty log says Chen Yan and Mo Yao couldn't meet. Their agreement stays open. The next shift follows the arrangements already in place.
en.值班簿记下：林岚和苏棠这次没能同席。这项协商暂时留空，原有职责仍按已经确认的安排: The duty log says Lin Lan and Su Tang couldn't meet. Their agreement stays open. The next shift follows the arrangements already in place.
en.值班簿记下：叶禾和莫遥这次没能同席。这项协商暂时留空，原有职责仍按已经确认的安排: The duty log says Ye He and Mo Yao couldn't meet. Their agreement stays open. The next shift follows the arrangements already in place.
en.值班簿记下：贺鸣和林岚这次没能同席。这项协商暂时留空，原有职责仍按已经确认的安排: The duty log says Lin Lan and He Ming couldn't meet. Their agreement stays open. The next shift follows the arrangements already in place.
en.值班簿记下：许舟和江朔这次没能同席。这项协商暂时留空，原有职责仍按已经确认的安排: The duty log says Xu Zhou and Jiang Shuo couldn't meet. Their agreement stays open. The next shift follows the arrangements already in place.
en.值班簿记下：苏棠和莫遥这次没能同席。这项协商暂时留空，原有职责仍按已经确认的安排: The duty log says Su Tang and Mo Yao couldn't meet. Their agreement stays open. The next shift follows the arrangements already in place.
en.值班簿记下：陈砚和贺鸣这次没能同席。这项协商暂时留空，原有职责仍按已经确认的安排: The duty log says Chen Yan and He Ming couldn't meet. Their agreement stays open. The next shift follows the arrangements already in place.
en.值班簿记下：叶禾和江朔这次没能同席。这项协商暂时留空，原有职责仍按已经确认的安排: The duty log says Ye He and Jiang Shuo couldn't meet. Their agreement stays open. The next shift follows the arrangements already in place.
en.两名居民分别困在前舱和后舱。先稳定伤员，再把他们送到出口。留意机器下一步会打到哪: Two residents are trapped, one in each cabin. Stabilize them and carry them to an exit. Check where the machines will strike next.
en.先切断接错的回路，再到诊所手摇供电。可以分派两个人，各守一处。备用组件有余力再拿: Disconnect the faulty circuit, then crank the clinic’s generator. You can station someone at each end. Take the spare parts if there’s time.
en.仓门挡住了救援箱。手动能开锁，有撬棍会更快。焊接机挡路时，可以先停机。: The relief crate is behind a locked door. You can open it by hand or speed things up with a crowbar. Shut down the welder if it blocks your way.
en.维修员还在棚下等着。先加固南北两处桥面，再接他离开。: The technician is waiting under cover. Brace the north and south spans before bringing him out.
en.先隔离失控泵，再启动排水。浅水能抄近路，涉水机放电时走干地更安全。: Isolate the runaway pump, then start draining the site. The shallows are a shortcut. Stay on dry ground when the skimmer discharges.
en.老人和孩子都要接到出口。搬运机沿右侧轨道巡行，去取档案箱前先看两人的撤离路线。: Get both the older resident and the child to an exit. A hauler patrols the tracks on the right. Check both escape routes before going for the archives.
en.切断作业电源，把维修员接出来。工具上的旧编号可以抄下，留给队里日后核对。: Cut the power to the work area and bring out the technician. Copy the serial number on the tools if you want the crew to look into it later.
en.清掉东西两处障碍，再启动补给车。给车头留出一格，别让队员挡住它。: Clear the obstructions to the east and west, then dispatch the supply truck. Keep its next tile clear so it can advance.
en.两名病人都需要转移。搬运时可以走连廊，或先布置绞盘。许舟达到5级后也能带人抛索。: Both patients need moving. Carry them along the walkway or set a winch first. At level 5, Xu Zhou can also use his grappling line while carrying someone.
en.测试南向出口和返向入口。守闸机挡路时，可以分头操作两个停机开关，省下正面拆机的时: Test the south exit and the return entrance. If the sentinel blocks your way, split up and work its two shutdown switches.
en.先断开工业门动力，再解除门锁。维护记录可以另外带走，留给当事人核对签字。: Cut power to the industrial door before unlocking it. You can also recover the maintenance record so the people involved can check the signature.
en.备份要经过两次环境结算。启动前先看终端会不会挨打，备份完成后把硬盘带走。: The backup takes two round ends. Check the threats to the terminal before you start it, then carry the drive out.
en.先隔离故障节点，再让日志安全下线。中继会召来巡检机，留人牵制增援能给取证争取时间: Isolate the faulty node, then take the log offline safely. The relay calls in scouts. Holding them off buys time to recover the warning record.
en.把药品带走，或恢复冷库供电，都能保住这批药。时间够的话两边都做，社区会记下这份额: Carry out the medicine or restore the cold room’s power. Either will save the stock. If you can do both, the community will remember the extra help.
en.三栋楼同时来电。先选一处能赶到的求援点，再决定还有余力回应哪一处。: Three buildings are calling at once. Pick a call you can reach, then see which others you still have time to answer.
en.先清出运输通道，再接居民登船。有余力时再带上物资箱。: Clear the transport lane, then help the residents aboard. Collect the supplies if the crew has time to spare.
en.修泵能保住排水能力，路远、工量也大。封闭支路更近，但街区状态上限会降至2。第一次: Repairing the pump preserves drainage but takes more travel and work. Sealing the branch is closer and caps the district’s condition at 2. Your first action on either branch commits you.
en.先解除干扰，再发出通告。广播需要维持两轮，可以留人保护终端，或先让附近机器停机。: Clear the interference and start the broadcast. It needs two rounds. Leave someone to protect the terminal or shut down nearby machines first.
en.病人和临时集合点都需要人手。可以让一人负责搬运，另两人去加固。: Both the patient and the assembly point need help. One person can take the patient while the other two reinforce the shelter.
en.先护住一所避难所。时间充足时，再支援另一所或转移两所之间的伤员。: Protect one shelter first. With time to spare, help the second shelter or bring out the injured person between them.
en.先恢复撤离主线。旧闸档案和备用路线标记分在别处，分人过去会拖慢主路施工。: Restore the main evacuation route. The old gate records and the backup route marker are elsewhere. Sending people after them leaves fewer hands on the main job.
en.先完成终端交接。可以同时核验报警记录，或删去无关者的姓名，为日后公开作准备。: Complete the terminal handover. You can also verify the warning record or remove bystanders’ names before anyone makes it public.
en.两组居民都在等船。先把人接走，再衡量是否绕去搬重建材料。今晚还要选定终战路线。: Two groups of residents are waiting for a boat. Get them aboard before deciding whether to detour for rebuilding supplies. Tonight the crew chooses its final route.
en.昨晚选定的路线决定这次任务。核对必做目标，给最后撤出的人留好通路。: Last night’s route determines today’s assignment. Check the required objectives and keep an exit clear for the last person out.
en.联络船修好，社区就能恢复往来。船票登记册可以一起带回。: Repair the ferry to reconnect the community. You can bring back the ticket ledger too.
en.药箱和旧书都有人等。带回一箱就能交差，另一箱要看现场余力。: People are waiting for both the medicine and the books. Bring back one crate to finish the assignment, or both if you have time.
en.先断开电梯驱动，再接乘客出来。: Cut power to the lift drive, then bring the passenger out.
en.可以把种箱带走，也可以固定灌溉架，让这片菜园继续生长。: Carry the seed box to safety or secure the irrigation frame so the garden can keep growing here.
en.先隔离配电柜，再取走绝缘布。留出一条能把布送到出口的路。: Isolate the electrical cabinet before collecting the insulation cloth. Leave a clear path to carry it out.
en.先找出住户的位置，再把人接出来。有余力时顺路送回保温盒。: Find the resident, then bring them to safety. Return the insulated meal box if you have time.
en.先把失联的记录员救出来。档案可以另行备份。: Rescue the missing clerk first. Making a separate copy of the files is optional.
en.行李装着私人物品，工具箱关系到今后谋生。选一箱带走。: The luggage holds personal belongings. The tools could help someone earn a living later. Choose a crate to take out.
en.把临时教室加固好。时间允许的话，再帮孩子们带出教材。: Reinforce the makeshift classroom. If time allows, bring the children’s teaching materials out too.
en.备用引航灯需要修复。可绕开守闸机，也可先用两个开关把它停下。: Repair the backup navigation light. Go around the sentinel or shut it down with both switches.
en.先接好诊所的后备供电。冷藏药柜还需要人持续照料，决定留下前先看机器的预告。: Connect the clinic’s backup power. The medicine fridge needs someone to keep watch. Check the machines’ forecasts before committing a crew member.
en.把社区名册带上船，家庭照片可以顺路抢救。这是最后一次可选出勤，之后还有一晚营地。: Get the community register aboard and save the family photos if you can. This is the last optional assignment. One night at camp remains.
en.制定轮换与明确接应: Plan the rotation and name the relief crew
en.战役结束后回到社区诊所: Return to the clinic after the rescue
en.如实登记缺失片段: Record the gap in the tape
en.给任务范围与停止条件: Agree on his remit and when to stop
en.以守约建立新的可靠性: Build trust by keeping the agreement
en.战役结束后去新的队伍: Join a new crew after the rescue
en.逐项核对她实际承担的工作: Check which calls were actually hers
en.先听她说完再谈排班: Let her finish before discussing shifts
en.保留她的专业调度但取消默认额外调解: Keep her on dispatch without automatic extra duties
en.建立由多人承担的轮值制度: Share the shifts among several people
en.战役结束后休假再归队: Take leave after the rescue, then return
en.保留完整附页及签名: Keep the full addendum with the signatures
en.先要求他逐条解释可验证的事实: Ask him to explain what can be checked
en.公开说明签字责任并设维修补偿专项: Acknowledge the signature and fund compensation
en.严格执行新验收，不承诺当前付不起的补偿: Tighten inspections and promise only what you can pay
en.承担责任并参与长期补偿: Take responsibility and help fund long-term compensation
en.保持严格履职与专业距离: Keep working together at a professional distance
en.战役结束后转幕后维修: Return to the repair bench after the rescue
en.把她的副本作为独立材料留存: Keep her copy as a separate source
en.征求同意后对照完整原件: Ask permission to check it against the original
en.用一次独立核查核对维护责任: Get an independent review of the maintenance record
en.保留质疑并明确独立作业边界: Keep the questions open and divide the work
en.继续追责，同时允许受约束的合作: Work together with safeguards and keep asking questions
en.承认专业能力但长期保持距离: Respect the work but keep a lasting distance
en.战役结束后另组社区维修队: Start a neighborhood repair crew after the rescue
en.允许他保留失踪者的名字与不确定性: Keep the missing person's name on the list
en.一起重看当时的撤退路线: Look over the retreat route together
en.明确安全边界后把行动授权交给队员: Set safety limits and let the crew decide
en.维持统一撤离口令: Use one agreed call to retreat
en.成为能交出控制权的保障者: Protect the crew while handing over control
en.维持事先说明的严格纪律: Keep the discipline agreed in advance
en.战役结束后转向避难所: Work at the shelter after the rescue
en.先核查技术签名再讨论公开: Check the technical signatures before discussing release
en.承诺只公开必要信息并脱敏: Remove names and publish only what's needed
en.将原件交独立核查机构，暂缓公开: Send the original for independent review and hold off publishing
en.参与公开技术审计: Take part in a public technical audit
en.留在有限互信的队伍: Stay with the crew on agreed terms
en.战役结束后离队并继续技术协助: Leave after the rescue and keep offering technical help
en.先核对欠款与物资归属: Check the unpaid wages and who owns the supplies
en.先让他处理家人的联系: Give him time to contact his family
en.结清一次明确拖欠并公示优先级: Pay the outstanding wages and post the priorities
en.经营共同所有的运输站: Run a jointly owned transport station
en.战役结束后选择家人与另一座城: Join his family in another city after the rescue
en.先断电再合作: Cut the power before working together
en.预先划清授权: Agree on what each person can decide
en.保持统一口令但分岗: Keep the same calls at separate posts
en.减少承诺只做当班: Commit only to the current shift
en.按来源逐条核实: Check each entry against its source
en.先保存再等证据: Keep the records until evidence arrives
en.征得接班者同意后排轮换: Ask the relief crew before setting the rota
en.各自明确下班边界: Agree when each person's shift ends
en.保留责任事实并脱敏: Keep the evidence and remove identifying details
en.暂缓公开交独立核查: Hold publication for an independent review
en.由患者状态决定优先级: Set priorities by the patient's condition
en.明确由当班医护判断: Leave the call to the medic on duty
en.逐项登记而不编结果: Record what each call actually tells you
en.写入负责人和期限: Write down a name and a deadline
en.留一碗给夜班: Save a bowl for the night shift
en.听完模仿: Hear the rest of his impression
en.请他关小声休息: Ask him to turn it down and get some rest
en.问名字由来: Ask how the laces got their name
en.陪他练一段: Practice a few steps with him
en.给新船起长名字: Give the new boat a long name
en.告诉他口味换了: Tell him your tastes have changed
en.挪到有光的地方: Move the plant into the light
en.请别人代养: Ask someone to look after the plant
en.送还孩子: Give the toy back to the child
en.帮她登记备用钥匙: Help her log a spare key
en.先一起等值班人: Wait with her for the person on duty
en.留一份给家人: Save a piece for the family
en.谈以后想做的事: Talk about what comes after this
en.改派东侧接应（2物资、替换普通出口为(8,8)、不获得后勤物资；须已达成苏棠与江: Move pickup east to (8,8) for 2 supplies. This replaces the regular exit and the supply gain. Su Tang must have a cooperation agreement with Jiang Shuo or Mo Yao, with one in the field and the other on logistics.
en.从未撤销的名单: The Name Still on the List
en.签名与转述: A Signature and a Secondhand Account
en.谁也不值最后一班: Neither of Us on the Last Shift
en.没有接通的电话: The Calls That Never Got Through
en.你们当时没有定下个人计划，这里还没有可以核对的履约记录。: You didn't agree on a personal plan. There's no promise on record to verify.
en.本晚项目或该成员项目已用完: Tonight's projects or this person's time are spoken for.
en.确认本段选择将占用1个重点项目及当事人；付费方案会在预览中显示资金变化。: Either reply uses one of tonight's project slots and the participant's time. Check the cost before confirming.
en.这项收束需要实际履约凭据。可等待、保留专业距离或选择战后生活。: This reply needs a promise you've kept. You can wait, keep a professional distance or choose what comes after the rescue.
en.林岚：我还没看到那次真正的交班。先把下一班安排清楚，再谈我能不能放心。: Lin Lan: I still haven't seen a real handover. Let's sort out who's on the next shift first.
en.许舟：我已经答应过了，但答应不等于做到。下次回来时再看表。: Xu Zhou: I've given my word. Next time I get back, check the clock. Then we'll know.
en.苏棠：表我看过了，还没有轮到别人真正接班。先别把“可以休息”当成“休息过了”。: Su Tang: I've seen the rota. I'm waiting for somebody else to actually take the shift. A break on paper isn't a break.
en.陈砚：账付了、名字写了，都还不算事情做完。缺的核查不能靠我自己签字补上。: Chen Yan: The money and my signature are on the books. There's a check still missing. I can't sign it off myself.
en.叶禾：我要看的记录还没核完。别先问我能不能放下。: Ye He: I still haven't seen all the records checked. Give me that before you ask me to let go.
en.贺鸣：纸上写了授权，还得看我下一次能不能真的让别人判断。: He Ming: I signed the authority over. Now I need to let them make the call out there.
en.莫遥：删节还没经过那次核验。现在说公开安全，太早了。: Mo Yao: Somebody still needs to check those redactions. It's too early to call this safe to publish.
en.江朔：先看这笔工资有没有付，再等到最后核账，看看之后有没有违背人员优先约定。条件: Jiang Shuo: First the wages. Then, when we close the books, we'll see if people really did go first.
en.切断错误总线 / 交接公开权限: Disconnect the faulty bus / Hand over public access
en.两条支路完成隔离，城市转入分区重建。各地恢复程度由已保全的设施和任务事实决定。: Both circuits are isolated. Reconstruction begins district by district, with the facilities and supplies each crew managed to save.
en.执行已选的共同控制、分区隔离或总撤离方案: Carry out the selected plan for Joint Control, district isolation or Citywide Evacuation.
en.主任务借调只填真实空位；支线可跳过；免费普通恢复继续计时。最高难度全部主角离队也: Main mission loan-fill only applies to actual open slots; side missions may be skipped; standard recovery continues timing freely. Even at max difficulty, citywide evacuation can conclude with all protagonists off-site—no non-existent characters appear in cutscenes.
en.撤离尾声增加清楚的指引事实，不把此支线设成总撤离门槛。: Add clear factual guidance at extraction's end; do not make this side branch a hard gate for citywide evacuation.
en.进入前选路线；共同控制走bus+auth，分区重建走west+east，总撤离走: Choose route before entry: joint control via bus+auth, district reconstruction via west+east, citywide evacuation via r1+r2—no hidden requirements are added across routes.

zh_TW.两处维修定位为可选应急后勤和社区修复，不作为常规成长循环或必做进度。默认不弹催修: 兩處維修定位為可選應急後勤與社區修復，不納入常規成長循環或必做進度。默認不彈出催修提醒；僅當玩家已安排的未來行動因疲勞失效、且有效期內後勤可解除該限制時，才顯示可選方案提示，仍並列呈現「休息」與「換人」。未知的未來收益不予預報。
zh_TW.他在停止条件旁签字，没再加“除非还有一个人”那句小字。: 他在停止條件旁簽字，未再加註「除非還有一個人」那句小字。
zh_TW.只有本版baseline生效；投影视图逐字匹配，36关/16能力/7装备/96剧: 僅本版baseline生效；投影視圖逐字匹配，共36關／16項能力／7種裝備／96則劇本引用完整，無歷史數值重新啟用。
zh_TW.我能让这台机器停一轮，给人留出施工时间。只是暂时断路，不等于它已经修好。: 我能讓這台機器停一輪，給人留出施工時間。只是暫時斷路，不等於它已經修好。
zh_TW.按本关有序轨道前进，到末端后下一轮反向；每轮最多2格。前方机器/不可移动装置阻挡: 依本關有序軌道前進，到末端後下一輪反向；每輪最多2格。前方機器／不可移動裝置阻擋則停止；人員依推移規則處理；屏障承受2傷害但本輪仍阻停。
zh_TW.接上的名单先交给接驳点；余下位置已经转给下一轮调度，不把仍在等待的人写成获救。: 接上的名單先交給接駁點；餘下位置已經轉給下一輪調度，不把仍在等待的人寫成獲救。
zh_TW.接到的人先安排，未接到的求援转交下一轮。没有人需要先证明“更值得救”。: 接到的人先安排，未接到的求援轉交下一輪。沒有人需要先證明「更值得救」。
zh_TW.本轮三个地址的救援目标未完成，最后已知位置已移交；没有自动补出的获救名单。: 本輪三個地址的救援目標未完成，最後已知位置已移交；沒有自動補出的獲救名單。
zh_TW.本轮只审查；即使设计达到开工条件也不开始写正式运行代码。: 本輪只審查；即使設計達到開工條件也不開始寫正式運行代碼。
zh_TW.本轮接驳没完成。我们会转交最后已知位置，但今天没带回来的人，不会出现在签收栏。: 本輪接駁沒完成。我們會轉交最後已知位置，但今天沒帶回來的人，不會出現在簽收欄。
zh_TW.本轮撤离顺序未能完成目标。余下缺口带入最后部署，最后一天仍可继续选择可用路线。: 本輪撤離順序未能完成目標。餘下缺口帶入最後部署，最後一天仍可繼續選擇可用路線。
zh_TW.本轮新增支出0；未采购或委托。: 本輪新增支出0；未採購或委託。
zh_TW.本轮有效prepare_safety标记，消费时再次检查保护者在场、站立与相邻。: 本輪有效prepare_safety標記，消費時再次檢查保護者在場、站立與相鄰。
zh_TW.本轮没有完成三个地址的救援目标。接线员将已送达的名单和仍待交接的求援条分开，交给: 本輪沒有完成三個地址的救援目標。接線員將已送達的名單和仍待交接的求援條分開，交給下一班。
zh_TW.本轮避难所目标未完成。后续按现有床位分流，不能把规划里的床算成已能使用。: 本輪避難所目標未完成。後續按現有床位分流，不能把規劃裡的床算成已能使用。
zh_TW.本轮门禁任务未完成。资料状态仍记未知，后续核查走现有公共渠道。: 本輪門禁任務未完成。資料狀態仍記未知，後續核查走現有公共渠道。
zh_TW.林岚：以后想种点能吃的东西。先把手养好，再从不容易死的开始。: 林嵐：以後想種點能吃的東西。先把手養好，再從不容易死的開始。
zh_TW.林岚：以后我想种点能吃的东西。先从不容易死的开始。: 林嵐：以後我想種點能吃的東西。先從不容易死的開始。
zh_TW.江朔：以后照约定来。交情之外，工钱和时间照样要算。: 江朔：以後照約定來。交情之外，工錢和時間照樣要算。
zh_TW.玩家阶段→锁定敌人动作→环境→目标检查→下一轮: 玩家階段→鎖定敵方動作→環境階段→目標檢查→下一輪。
zh_TW.目前需要等待下一轮行动点恢复。结束回合也会执行机器预告和环境变化。: 目前需要等待下一輪行動點恢復。結束回合也會執行機器預告和環境變化。
zh_TW.苏棠：结束之后我想休一阵子。回来要做什么，等休够再说。: 蘇棠：結束之後我想休一陣子。回來要做什麼，等休夠再說。
zh_TW.莫遥完成派驻交接，关键资料不绑定她必须在队: 莫遙完成派駐交接，關鍵資料不綁定她必須在隊。
zh_TW.要求人员轮换或追加撤离保障；重度失信后提出下一班停止带队。: 要求人員輪換或追加撤離保障；重度失信後提出下一班停止帶隊。
zh_TW.贺鸣看着一段舞蹈录像，脚步总在同一个地方慢半拍。: 賀鳴看著一段舞蹈影片，腳步總在同一個地方慢半拍。
zh_TW.贺鸣：记录里的这件事由我负责。之前做到过的还在，但不能拿它抵掉这一次。: 賀鳴：記錄裡的這件事由我負責。之前做到過的還在，但不能拿它抵掉這一次。
zh_TW.陈砚把写满的一页推过去。莫遥没有先读末尾的结论，而是把纸轻轻转回他面前。: 陳硯把寫滿的一頁推過去。莫遙沒有先讀末尾的結論，而是把紙輕輕轉回他面前。
zh_TW.陈砚按社区派驻安排在结算后加入，并非任务救出的唯一人质: 陳硯依社區派駐安排於結算後加入，並非本次任務所救出的唯一人質。
